ideas.name: Updraft
ideas.approachWhy: Each variant is a small set of columns, ledges and goo shelves; the fun is in hand-placed heights and timings, and there are too few pieces for a generator to add much.

have: lift motion: see-through wind column that raises the local player at FAN_LIFT = 30 studs/s (FanShaft)
gust motion with axis, power and on/off duty (GustyBridge); with axis x it is a forward-carrying wind tunnel
slide motion (for a fan on a rail or a sliding exit ledge) and spin motion (spinning goo bar)
tests already treat a lift as a valid way to reach a step

new.what: on/off timer for lift and gust columns: reuse the shared flip clock (period, duty, phase) that Moon Pulse (idea 28) and the erupt beat (idea 21) also use, plus a fade warning on the swirl and the fan hum
lift power per column (slow column) and a hover cap that holds you at the top instead of throwing you
lift catches a falling player: on entry the client sets the upward speed instead of adding to the fall (check in Studio)
lift region follows a moving fan: put the column on idea 3's 'ride' motion (stops with hold time) and its rail line look, and check the client uses the part's live position
hazard touch = back to the start pad for goo shelves and bars (shared with every hazard idea, see idea 1)
one client zone check for lift, gust and the moon zone (idea 28), so the three wind/gravity zones don't fight over the character
streamers and leaves that rise with the wind, plus a fan hum that drops in pitch before a column switches off
test rules for lift reach: rise and exit distance per column, drop-in catch height, column-to-column hand-offs, and for timed columns the time to rise vs the on-time

ideas.readability: A dark fan on the floor blows a see-through column with white swirls, rising leaves and a ring at the top, with a steady fan hum. A column about to switch off fades its swirl and the hum drops; a hover cap shows as a bright ring where you stop; a moving fan sits on a visible rail.

variants.name: First Breeze
variants.does: One tall wind column: step in, float straight up, walk off onto the high ledge.
variants.numbers: 1 column 8x8, rise 12, wind tops out 4 over the ledge

variants.name: Lazy Lift
variants.does: A slow, wide column: you rise gently and have lots of time to steer to the ledge.

variants.name: Hover Shelf
variants.does: The column holds you floating at the top instead of throwing you, so you can line up and walk off.
variants.numbers: 1 column 8x8, rise 10, hovers 2 over the ledge, ledge 5 away

variants.name: Catch the Fall
variants.does: Walk off a high ledge and drop into a column below: the wind brakes your fall and carries you up to the far ledge.
variants.numbers: drop 12 into a 10x10 column, rise 14, exit ledge 2 below the start

variants.name: Hand-Off
variants.does: Two columns overlap in the air, the second one higher: step sideways out of the first one's hover into the second, over a safe floor.
variants.numbers: column A rise 10 with hover cap, column B 6 to the side rising 12 more, solid floor under both

variants.name: First Crosswind
variants.does: A gentle wind tunnel along the course carries you over a gap you could not jump: walk in and hold forward.
variants.numbers: tunnel 14 long, pushes forward 14 studs/s, gap 12, always on

variants.name: Blink Column
variants.does: The column switches off for a moment on a timer; the swirl fades first, so start your ride when it just came on.
variants.numbers: 1 column, rise 14, 4 s on, 1.5 s off, 0.8 s fade warning

variants.name: Relay Fans
variants.does: Two columns side by side take turns: halfway up the first one fades, so step sideways into the second as it comes on, with no ledge in between.
variants.numbers: 2 columns 8x8 touching, 4 s cycle each, half a cycle apart, 0.8 s overlap, rise 8 + 10

variants.name: Drifting Column
variants.does: The fan rides on a rail and the column glides back and forth, pausing at each end: step in as it passes, step off when it lines up with the ledge.
variants.numbers: 1 column 8x8 sliding 10 studs, 5 s round trip, 1 s pause at each end, rise 12

variants.name: Moving Exit
variants.does: The column holds you at the top while the exit ledge slides up and down beside you: wait in the hover and step off when it arrives.
variants.numbers: 1 column 8x8, rise 12, hover cap, exit ledge slides 8 up and down, 4 s round trip

variants.name: Goo Ring Climb
variants.does: A wide column with red goo shelves sticking in from the sides at different heights: steer round them as you rise.

variants.name: Crosswind Shelf
variants.does: Ride up, then a sideways wind tunnel along the course carries you over a wide gap to the far ledge; just hold forward.
variants.numbers: column rise 10, then a 16-stud wind tunnel pushing forward at 14 studs/s

variants.name: Zigzag Tower
variants.does: Three columns climb a tower, each ledge on the other side from the last: you turn round in the air every ride.
variants.numbers: 3 columns, rise 10 each (30 total), ledges swap left and right

variants.name: Spinner Shaft
variants.does: A red goo bar spins through the middle of the column: step in so you pass its height while it is on the far side.
variants.numbers: 1 column 12x12, rise 16, goo bar 10 long spinning every 3 s

variants.name: Storm Shaft
variants.does: A blinking column with goo shelves inside: steer round the shelves and reach the top before the wind cuts out.
variants.numbers: 1 column 12x12, rise 20, 5 s on, 1.5 s off, 3 goo shelves

variants.name: Sky Hop
variants.does: No ledges between the columns: walk out of each column's hover and drop across into the next one, higher each time.
variants.numbers: 4 columns 8x8, hover caps, 4-stud air gaps, each top 8 higher, fans on thin posts

variants.name: Gust Gap
variants.does: Ride up into a forward wind tunnel that blinks on and off over a long gap: enter just as it comes on, or it cuts out mid-gap and you drop.
variants.numbers: column rise 12, tunnel 24 long, 14 studs/s forward, 2.4 s on, 1.6 s off, 0.6 s fade warning
